errors.evidence: The Bulgaria line starts at a value of approximately 110 in 1980, not 160.

errors.text_span: покачва се до около 180 през 1985 година
errors.evidence: In 1985, the value for the Bulgaria line is approximately 160, not 180.
The peak of approximately 210 occurs just before 1995 (around 1993-1994), not in 1995. In 1995, the value is lower, around 190.
In 2015, the value for the Bulgaria line is approximately 25, not 50.

errors.text_span: като завършва на стойност около 40 през 2017 година
errors.evidence: The Bulgaria line ends at a value just below 25 around 2017, not 40.

errors.text_span: Линията е хоризонтална и се намира на стойност 25 по оста Y
errors.evidence: The OECD line is a horizontal line at the value of 0 on the Y-axis, not 25. The model was likely misled by the red '(25)' label next to the '0' on the axis.

errors.text_span: като диапазонът обхваща от 1980 до 2017 година
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the range of the x-axis is from 1980 to 2017. The axis labels only go up to 2015; it is the data line that extends to approximately 2017.
The description omits the qualitative labels on the Y-axis: 'Higher Risk' with an upward arrow and 'Lower Risk' with a downward arrow.
